name: Government Cloud modular data centers (x2)
developer: Government of Burkina Faso / MTDPCE / ANPTIC
notes: Two government modular data centers in Ouagadougou (Centre/Kadiogo), inaugurated 2026-01-23 under the data-sovereignty program; ANPTIC board session confirms the January 2026 inauguration. Combined reported capacity ~3 PB storage, 105.6 TB RAM, 28,800 CPU cores, 7,000+ VMs; ~15.2-16 bn FCFA; 5-10 days energy autonomy. Exact physical addresses not public; two sites represented as one project pending address confirmation.

name: National Big Data Center (target 2028)
notes: Announced national Big Data Center to be completed by 2028, next step after the Jan-2026 modular DCs; intended to repatriate public and private data hosted abroad. Location (Ouagadougou assumed) and capacity not disclosed.

name: Virtix Data Center
notes: Ouaga 2000 (Palais des Sports area), Ouagadougou. Best commercial colo seed: official site confirms Tier3 built facility with N+1 cabinets and colocation services; dual fibre ring to BFIX; PeeringDB fac 11598 (4 networks, 1 local exchange). ~1,200 m2 / 3 MW figures are directory-grade (C); 'Tier 3/hyperscale' claims self-reported unless Uptime record found.

name: UV-BF Datacenter de l'Education
developer: Universite Virtuelle du Burkina Faso / ANPTIC
notes: Education-dedicated data center launched 20 Sep 2022 in Ouagadougou (Sidwaya, state-affiliated press). Matches ANPTIC indexed title 'LANCEMENT OFFICIEL DU DATACENTER DE L'EDUCATION'. Education/government function, not commercial colo; dedup against ANPTIC/G-Cloud estate.

name: Orange Burkina Faso telco-core data center (Balkuy)
notes: Telco-core data center at Balkuy, Ouagadougou; SolarX solarization covers ~37% of site power needs (2023). Orange Burkina Faso licensed operator (ARCEP) and peers at BFIX (PeeringDB net 11110). No public colo product page; classified as telco-core DC.

name: IKA Cloud
notes: Avenue de la Dignite, Cissin/Secteur 26, Ouagadougou; local hosting/colo platform per BF methodology (address/advertised services A). 'Premier datacenter' claim is marketing (Virtix predates it). Physical facility vs reseller/platform unverified this run - grade U pending site confirmation.

name: Alink Telecom Datacenter
notes: Colocation-oriented datacenter in Ouagadougou per DataCenterPlatform (2 locations listed in BF). Directory-only evidence; requires ARCEP licence, operator page, BFIX or customer evidence before upgrading above C.

name: IPSyS TELECOM Datacenter
notes: Telecom-oriented datacenter at Avenue Kwame Nkrumah, Ouagadougou per directories; company site exists. Verify whether address is facility vs office before upgrading above C.

name: Datacenter Immeuble du Faso (BFIX)
notes: PeeringDB-listed facility (fac 3189) at BFIX HQ, Immeuble du Faso, Avenue de l'Independance, Ouagadougou, hosting the BFIX Ouagadougou IXP; ~3,229 sq ft per DataCenterJournal (2020). Interconnection presence (B) but commercial-DC classification unconfirmed (C).

name: Datacenter Ministere de l'agriculture (BFIX)
notes: PeeringDB-listed facility (fac 7598) in Ouagadougou operated by BFIX; ~22,970 sq ft per DataCenterJournal (2020). Legacy facility; current owner/status needs verification.

name: Essor Services / Kaia Energy waste-to-energy data center
notes: Announced Jul 2024: data center powered by ~12 MW waste-to-energy plant (12 MW is plant capacity, not DC IT load); completion targeted Nov 2025. Site not public; no EIA/permit/construction evidence found as of Aug 2026 - kept speculative.

name: National Digital Infrastructure Supervision Center (NOC)
notes: Construction launched 19 Jan 2026 in Ouagadougou by Minister Aminata Zerbo-Sabane; ~USD 5.4M (Ecofin); targeted operational Oct 2026. NOC/operations building supervising backbone, cybersecurity and state DCs - per BF methodology not counted as a colocation datacenter; tracked as join target for state DC operations.
